en.headline: Thunderstorm warning extended until 9.30am
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory has kept the Thunderstorm Warning in force until 9.30 a.m., with isolated thunderstorms still expected over the territory this morning.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning remains effective until 9.30 a.m. on Saturday. Isolated thunderstorms are expected to occur over Hong Kong.

More than 10 millimetres of rainfall were recorded over many places earlier this morning under a broad trough of low pressure affecting the coast of Guangdong. Conditions remain mainly cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms, and showers may be heavy at times. The maximum temperature is forecast around 28 degrees Celsius with moderate east to southeasterly winds.

Members of the public are advised to seek safe shelter when outdoors and stay away from highly conductive objects, trees or masts. The Observatory expects heavy showers with thunderstorms to continue at times tomorrow and on Monday.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至上午9時30分
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示雷暴警告繼續生效至上午9時30分，預期本港仍有局部地區出現雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，雷暴警告繼續有效至星期六上午9時30分。預期本港有局部地區雷暴。
受廣泛低壓槽影響，今早本港多處錄得超過10毫米雨量。天氣繼續多雲，有驟雨及狂風雷暴，雨勢有時頗大。氣溫約28度，吹和緩東至東南風。
市民在戶外時應盡快尋找安全地方躲避，並遠離高導電物體、樹木或桅杆。展望明日及星期一仍有大驟雨及雷暴。
